record_title: Efficient randomized parity queries without large monochromatic affine subspaces
provenance: The Wang-Wu total communication function is recognized as an XOR function. Its sampled Gap-Hamming address stage and fully linear PCP verification stage descend to parity queries, while its monochromatic-rectangle bound transfers to a codimension lower bound for monochromatic affine subspaces of the XOR quotient.
limitations: The descent uses the special linear structure of the Wang-Wu protocol and does not give a general randomized communication-to-parity-query simulation for XOR functions. The polynomial codimension exponent is inherited from their parameters. The consequence is short enough that near-simultaneous or folklore priority risk is material.
